The '''Dac Peace Conference''' was a meeting between representatives of the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] peoples. The two groups' long rivalry had become inflamed shortly after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was driven off of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]]. The Peace Conference was an attempt to repair the relations between the two groups, thereby preventing a civil war.<ref name="Strongholds" />
